cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

mechanism: A recruits B into a leaving-party diversion by correcting an over-obvious invitation and an unfinished-work excuse with detailed professional preparation.
confusable: Simple task-sharing lacks the exact corrective expertise and growing strain used to keep the secret credible.
comparison: Family alternative controls a baking demonstration; office alternative fixes a spreadsheet obstacle and the wording of coffee cover.
seedUse: Denise seed supplies surprise decorating and spreadsheet prerequisite; S03 should supply an operational correction rather than just promise to take the task.
